events.what: Agugliaro constructs infinitely many abelian varieties of dimension g>=5 over finite fields satisfying the Hodge standard conjecture
Agugliaro proves the Hodge standard conjecture for powers of abelian threefolds, powers of simple abelian varieties of prime dimension over finite fields, and Frobenius-rank cases
Truong derives consequences assuming standard conjecture D
Foster proves Lefschetz standard conjectures for 4-dimensional Kummer-type varieties conditional on the Buchweitz-Flenner conjecture
Hodge standard conjecture for self-products of K3 surfaces

judgement.doubts: Record codes agree with derivation. The researcher's reasoning that an unreviewed case is 'partial' rather than 'claimed' reached the right code for the wrong reason (scope, not rigour, decides). Both Agugliaro events are partial-tier cases; the 2024 one (accepted per the record for Documenta Mathematica) alone would also give partial, so status is robust. Floccari-Varesco proves the Hodge/Tate conjectures, a variant, correctly excluded.
